messages:
alex_ryan: Heads up — staging p95 jumped ~60% after yesterday's model-onboard merge (checkpoint v7.1). Looks correlated with KV cache miss rate increases and kernel selector falling back. :warning:

priya: I saw that on the dashboard too. Traces show a lot of `generic_attention` kernels getting used for longer sequences. KV cache hitrate dropped sharply on corals pool.

miguel: Ran a quick flamegraph. Kernel switch points are happening more frequently (many short-lived kernels). Summary:
```
Profiling summary:
- KV cache hitrate: 62% (baseline 92%)
- kernel_selector: fallback_count=1873 -> generic_attention
- avg_token_latency: p50 8.3ms -> 12.4ms, p95 12.4ms -> 20.1ms
- hotspot: runtime/kernel/selector.cpp:line 241
commit: abc1234 (runtime/kernel/thresholds)
```

sam: CI perf alert fired on the nightly mlperf-latency job after the runtime change: `ci-perf-bot` posted regression +8% p95 for onnx-e2e. I think the kernel threshold tweak in abc1234 is the suspect.

infra-bot: Deploy note: model-onboard v7.1 used new tokenizer mapping which changed tokenization length distribution for some locales (+12% longer sequences). That may interact with batching heuristics.

yan: tokenizer change + kernel threshold change = perfect storm. Tokenizer now emits more EOS padding in a few languages which increases KV lookups and causes premature cache evictions.

alex_ryan: Miguel, can you try git-bisect locally against the runtime change and run the perf bench? If we can confirm a minimal repro, we can either revert abc1234 or add a checkpoint-specific selector override.

miguel: Starting bisect: `git bisect start HEAD v7.0 && git bisect run ./bench/perf_smoke.sh --p95` — will post result in ~20m.

(prior update) miguel: bisect points to abc1234 as the first bad commit. Reproduced perf delta when onboarding checkpoint v7.1 + tokenizer mapping file `token_map_v3`.

sam: Temporary mitigation idea: add a kernel selector override for v7.1 to prefer `native_attention` and lower fallback aggressiveness. Example command: `redwoodctl feature set kernel.selector.overrides '{"checkpoint":"v7.1","preferred":"native_attention","fallback_threshold":0.8}'`

dave: Can we also pause rollout for v7.1 in staging and prod? I put a hold on the canary group in the console, but need ops to block further rollouts.

infra-bot: Rollout paused for checkpoint v7.1: canary groups stopped. Notifying release leads.

priya: Long term: we should make kernel selector aware of tokenizer-induced length distribution shifts and expose a per-checkpoint hint during onboarding so we don't rely on brittle heuristics. Filed an RFC: rfc/kernel-selector-checkpoint-hints.

alex_ryan: Action items:
- miguel: open PR that reverts the threshold change in abc1234 or adds a config flag to disable aggressive fallback (WIP).
- sam/ops: keep rollout paused and watch for any queued deploys.
- priya: land RFC for selector hints + add a pre-onboard perf-check that simulates typical length distro.
- yan: add a temporary KV cache boost for corals pool to see if it cushions the p95 while we fix selector logic.

alex_ryan: Thanks. I'll update the incident channel with the bisect link and the temporary override we applied. If anyone finds a smaller repro or a better workaround post the command and perf numbers. :thumbsup:
